stories.title: Haenen stopt na vijftig jaar als stem van Bert, na het overlijden van ‘zijn’ Ernie, Wim T. Schippers, ‘uit eerbied en voor de vriendschap’

en.title: Haenen stops after fifty years as voice of Bert, following the death of 'his' Ernie, Wim T. Schippers, 'out of respect and for the friendship'
en.summary: A voice actor for the character Bert has ended a fifty-year career following the death of the actor who played Ernie.

stories.title: Zanger Ed Sheeran betuigt spijt over het schrappen van pro-Palestijnse rapper Macklemore

en.title: Singer Ed Sheeran expresses regret over removing pro-Palestinian rapper Macklemore
en.summary: Ed Sheeran has apologized for removing pro-Palestinian rapper Macklemore from a project or performance.

stories.title: Alle 24 verdachten van rellen Malieveld zijn inmiddels vrijgelaten

en.title: All 24 suspects from Malieveld riots have now been released
en.summary: Twenty-four people arrested during a demonstration at Malieveld have been released, though it remains unclear whether they received fines or summonses.

stories.title: Acht doden en dertig gewonden bij Russische aanvallen op Oekraïne

en.title: Eight dead and thirty wounded in Russian attacks on Ukraine
en.summary: Russian attacks on Ukraine resulted in eight fatalities and thirty injuries.

stories.title: Paul Haenen stopt als Bert in Sesamstraat: 'Waar ben je nou Ernie, ik mis je'

en.title: Paul Haenen stops as voice of Bert in Sesame Street: 'Where are you now Ernie, I miss you'
en.summary: Actor Paul Haenen is retiring after over fifty years as the voice of Bert in the Dutch version of Sesame Street, citing the death of his longtime colleague Wim T. Schippers who voiced Ernie. Haenen will also stop voicing Grover.

stories.title: Video | Zo maakte Paul Haenen bekend dat hij stopt met de stem van Bert

en.title: Video | How Paul Haenen announced he is quitting as the voice of Bert
en.summary: Paul Haenen announced his retirement from voicing Bert in Sesame Street in a video broadcast on television.

stories.title: OM gaat 74-jarige man vervolgen voor maken deepfakeporno van BN'ers

en.title: Prosecutors to prosecute 74-year-old man for making deepfake pornography of Dutch celebrities
en.summary: Dutch prosecutors have decided to prosecute a 74-year-old man from North Holland for creating sexual deepfakes of numerous well-known Dutch women, after an investigation lasting over a year. He faces up to two years in prison.

stories.title: Paul Haenen stopt als Bert uit Sesamstraat na dood collega: 'Waar ben je, Ernie?'

en.title: Paul Haenen stops as Bert from Sesame Street after colleague's death: 'Where are you, Ernie?'
en.summary: Paul Haenen is ending his over fifty-year career voicing Bert in Sesame Street following the death of colleague Wim T. Schippers in June, who provided the voice for Ernie.

stories.title: Alle 24 verdachten van rellen bij extreemrechts protest op Malieveld vrijgelaten

en.title: All 24 suspects in riots at far-right protest at Malieveld released
en.summary: Twenty-four suspects from Saturday's riots at The Hague's Malieveld have been released by police. Most had already been let go on Saturday.

stories.title: Tien leeuwen in Tanzania dood gevonden na mogelijke vergiftiging

en.title: Ten lions found dead in Tanzania after possible poisoning
en.summary: Ten lions have been discovered dead in Tanzania following suspected exposure to toxic substance. Authorities are still investigating what occurred and who may be responsible.

stories.title: Tien leeuwen in Tanzania dood gevonden, mogelijk vergiftigd

en.title: Ten lions found dead in Tanzania, possibly poisoned
en.summary: Ten dead lions have been found in Tanzania's Ngorongoro nature reserve. The NCAA authority managing the reserve is conducting investigations into the cause of death and seeking to identify those responsible for the possible poisoning.

stories.title: Ed Sheeran erkent fouten tijdens eerste concert sinds ophef rond schrappen Macklemore

en.title: Ed Sheeran acknowledges mistakes at first concert since Macklemore removal controversy
en.summary: Ed Sheeran apologized at his first performance following Macklemore's removal from his tour's opening act, stating he made mistakes in the situation and addressing Gaza's humanitarian crisis at a Philadelphia concert.
